anchors.20: Names a specific situation, number or claim in the first 1-3 s; creates tension or curiosity; payload in the first words; speaks to the viewer.
anchors.14: Specific and clear but no tension, or tension but vague.
anchors.8: Generic opener ("오늘은 ~에 대해 알려드릴게요"), brand name first, or the point arrives after 3 s.
anchors.2: No hook: logo, greeting, or silence first.

anchors.15: One idea, concrete nouns and numbers, short sentences, no filler, reads like a person.
anchors.10: Clear but padded or two competing ideas.
anchors.5: Vague benefits, buzzwords, AI tells (em dashes, stock phrases).
anchors.1: Hard to say what it is about.

anchors.10: One ask, low effort, says what happens next ("저장해두고 장 볼 때 보세요", "프로필 링크에서 사이즈표 확인").

anchors.15: Clear value, a real reason to act now (end date, limited stock, first-order deal) or, for organic reels, an obvious save/share payoff.
